title: Calypso's Isle
sub: Build the raft, stud by stud, and launch it

cue.hand: Pinch a timber, carry it onto the keel, open your hand over its shadow: the studs click.
cue.mouse: Drag a timber onto its lit place on the keel and let go.
cue.keys: Tab picks the next timber, Space lifts it, Tab moves it to its place, Space drops it.
